description: This file defines the GaugesPanel class, which manages the user interface for displaying gauges, messages, and controls related to sensors in a vehicle tuning application. It includes UI components, configuration handling, and interaction logic.

classes.name: GaugesPanel
classes.description: Main class managing the gauges UI panel, including layout, configuration, and user interactions.

classes.name: GaugesPanel.DetachedRepository
classes.description: Singleton managing a collection of DetachedSensor objects, including loading, saving, and modifying the list.

methods.name: GaugesPanel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the gauges panel with configuration, setting up UI components and event listeners.

methods.name: createMiddleLeftPanel
methods.description: Creates the left part of the middle split panel containing gauges and RPM label.

methods.name: createTopPanel
methods.description: Creates the top panel with controls and menu buttons.

methods.name: createRightTopPanel
methods.description: Creates the right side of the top panel with size selector and menu button.

methods.name: createMenu
methods.description: Builds the context menu with options to toggle RPM, commands, logs, and reset config.

methods.name: prepareMessagesPanel
methods.description: Initializes the messages panel with buttons and message display.

methods.name: createLeftTopPanel
methods.description: Creates the left side of the top panel with pause, save image buttons, RPM label, and command input.

methods.name: createPauseButton
methods.description: Creates a button to pause/resume data updates.

methods.name: createSaveImageButton
methods.description: Creates a button to save the current gauges view as an image.

methods.name: setSensorGridDimensions
methods.description: Adjusts the grid layout of gauges and loads sensor elements.

methods.name: applyShowFlags
methods.description: Shows or hides RPM and message panels based on user settings.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main UI component of the gauges panel.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Saves the list of detached sensors to configuration.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a detached sensor to the list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a detached sensor from the list.
